title: Velora Helicopter Tours of Knoxville
specs: Scenic views of downtown Knoxville, Tennessee River, Neyland Stadium, and surrounding landscapes
Flights operated by licensed, highly trained pilots with local knowledge
Modern, well-maintained helicopters designed for sightseeing with large windows
Beginner-friendly with safety briefing and smooth flights
Children must be able to sit securely with a seatbelt; age requirements may vary
Weight restrictions per passenger and per flight; accurate weight may be required at check-in
Most helicopters seat 4–6 passengers depending on aircraft and weight limits
includes: Well-maintained helicopters with large viewing windows
blurb: Velora Helicopter Tour offers scenic aerial sightseeing experiences showcasing Knoxville, the Tennessee River, and surrounding East Tennessee landscapes. Tours are designed for all experience levels, including first-time flyers and families. Flights focus on comfort, safety, and breathtaking views with licensed pilots and well-maintained helicopters.
extraNote: Tours operate only when weather conditions are safe · Advance booking strongly recommended, especially for weekends, sunset flights, and peak periods
